visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-definition close-up of a finished rose-shaped apple pie. The pastry is golden brown and flaky, with thin, red-edged apple slices arranged in a tight spiral to mimic rose petals. Fine white powdered sugar is dusted across the top, enhancing the visual texture. (2) A pair of hands wearing white protective gloves is shown over a wooden surface. They add cinnamon powder, sugar, and lemon juice into a glass bowl filled with thin apple slices. The hands then gently mix the ingredients, ensuring each slice is coated. (3) The scene shifts to a person using a white rolling pin to flatten a circular piece of dough on parchment paper. After flattening, they use a large kitchen knife to cut the dough into uniform rectangular strips approximately three centimeters wide. (4) Red rose jam is spread onto the center of a dough strip using a small metal spoon. Thin apple slices are then carefully layered along the top edge of the strip in an overlapping pattern. The bottom of the dough is folded up, and the entire assembly is rolled tightly to form a floral shape. (5) The hand places the prepared rose pastries into a dark metal muffin tin. The tin is then slid onto a metal rack inside a bright oven with a patterned glass door. (6) The final shot returns to the baked pies, beautifully presented on a black slate, with the camera zooming in slowly to show the glistening caramelized edges of the apple slices and the delicate sugar dusting.
